user.title: Evolute sign-in
user.description: Choose how to sign in to your evassist.ru account.

phone.title: Sign in by phone
phone.description: Enter the phone number used in your Evolute account. On the next step, request an SMS code on the official website.

sms.title: Enter the SMS code
sms.description:
1. Open the [official login page]({login_url}) in a private browser window.
2. Enter **{phone_number}**, complete the CAPTCHA and request an SMS code.
3. Enter the 4-digit code **here in Home Assistant**, without entering it on the website. The code can only be used once.

To request another code, use the same official page.

token.title: Sign in with tokens
token.description: Enter the cookies `evy-platform-access` and `evy-platform-refresh` from app.evassist.ru. For a new connection, also enter the car ID from the car page URL.

select_car.title: Select your car
select_car.description: Choose a car from your account. If loading failed, submit this step again to retry without requesting another SMS code.

error.invalid_phone: Enter a valid phone number with country code, for example +7 999 123-45-67.
error.invalid_code: Enter the 4-digit code from the SMS.
error.invalid_car: Choose a car from the list.
error.invalid_auth: The SMS code is incorrect, expired or already used. Request a new code on the official login page.
error.invalid_tokens: The tokens are invalid or expired. Enter a valid access and refresh token pair.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to evassist.ru or read its response. Try again.
error.rate_limited: Too many requests. Wait before trying again.
error.session_expired: The session expired. Request a new SMS code on the official login page.

abort.no_cars: No cars were found in this personal account.
abort.wrong_account: This account does not have the car being reauthenticated. Sign in to the account that has access to it.
abort.entry_removed: The integration entry has been removed.

init.title: Evolute options
init.description: Adjust polling and request settings. To sign in again, select Reconfigure in the integration entry menu.
